task.title: A topic fails the text check
task.shortdesc: The migrated page has different words from the published page. The report shows the words on each side.

context.p: Cause: Usually an element that DITA-OT's Markdown writer drops or changes, such as a figure caption, a step label or a generated word.

step.cmd: Open the topic on the run detail and compare the DITA and MyST text the difference names.
Find the source element that holds the missing words.
If the element has no Markdown form, approve or write a mapping rule for it.
